decisions_log.decision: Used Array<{year, count}> prop shape for YearFilter (the 'Should' requirement) rather than parallel years: number[] + yearCounts map.
decisions_log.rationale: Couples year and count in a single object element so they cannot drift apart. Matches the spec's 'Should' and the design's recommended prop shape.

decisions_log.decision: Derived yearCountMap with a plain for-of loop rather than a Set + sort chain.
decisions_log.rationale: The constraint says derive inline from the same entries array; a simple loop produces the count map and the sorted unique-year list in one pass without introducing memoisation or module-level precomputation.

decisions_log.decision: Did not use useMemo for per-year count derivation.
decisions_log.rationale: The design defers this decision to the engineer; the entry set is small (single-digit in production today) so a straight reduction is acceptable per the spec. No memoisation added.

@testing-library/user-event is not in the project's package.json and the SWE constraints prohibit adding new dependencies. fireEvent.change is already used in the existing ChangelogFilteredList.test.tsx and is sufficient to assert AC5.

files_changed.summary: Changed prop shape from years: number[] to years: Array<{year, count}> plus totalCount: number. Each <option> now renders '${year} (${count})' and the default renders 'All years (${totalCount})'. No ARIA overrides; <label> and aria-label preserved exactly.

Replaced Set-based year derivation with an inline yearCountMap loop over entries, producing years: Array<{year, count}> sorted newest-first. Added totalCount = entries.length. Passes both to YearFilter. Counts come from the same entries array as the list.
Updated all YearFilter renders to pass the new years: Array<{year, count}> and totalCount props. Existing toHaveTextContent (substring) assertions still pass unchanged.
Fixed line-37 strict-equality check (t === '2026') to t.startsWith('2026') so it survives count-appended option text.
New test file covering AC1-AC4, AC6, AC7: exact option text format, empty state, no singular/plural word, no ARIA overrides on options, native select structure.
New test file covering AC5 and AC8: option count equals rendered list length after selection; count paragraph above filter still shows total entries with no year selected.

self_assessment.notes: All 9 Must requirements implemented. All 8 ACs covered by tests (AC1-AC4, AC6, AC7 in YearFilter.countInOption.test.tsx; AC5, AC8 in ChangelogFilteredList.counts.test.tsx). 29 tests pass, lint clean, tsc --noEmit clean. No new dependencies added. Both files remain 'use client'. Counts derived inline from the same entries array. <option> elements are text-only with no ARIA overrides. Label and aria-label preserved exactly.
